svg.title: WebSocket Chat System — AWS Architecture
svg.desc: 3 WebSocket clients connect via AWS ALB to 4 Spring Boot servers on EC2. Servers bidirectionally use Redis ElastiCache for pub/sub and session cache, and publish to Amazon MQ (RabbitMQ). A Consumer service reads from RabbitMQ, uses Redis for analytics caching, and batch-writes to Amazon RDS PostgreSQL.
